claim.label: 1 Claim
claim.function: Claimant submits a claim with evidence and mapped area

verify.label: 2 Verify
verify.full_name: Gram Sabha and Forest Rights Committee verification
verify.function: Gram Sabha initiates the process; Forest Rights Committee assists verification

resolution.label: 3 Gram Sabha
resolution.function: Gram Sabha considers claims and passes a resolution

sdlc.label: 4 Subdiv review
sdlc.function: Examines the Gram Sabha resolution and prepares the record of rights; includes Revenue, Forest and Tribal Affairs officials and PRI members

sdo.label: 5 SDO handoff
sdo.function: Sub-Divisional Officer forwards the SDLC record to the District Level Committee

dlc.label: 6 Final decision
dlc.function: District Level Committee considers and finally approves the record

vested.label: 7 Rights
vested.full_name: Recognition and vesting of forest rights
vested.function: Approved record recognizes the forest rights that apply

individual.label: 8 Individual
individual.function: Habitation and livelihood cultivation rights, among other listed rights

community.label: 8 Community
community.function: Customary access, use, collection, grazing and other community rights

cfr.label: 9 Forest
cfr.function: Community forest resource protected, regenerated or managed by the community

mfp.label: 9 Produce
mfp.function: Traditional collection, use and disposal rights for minor forest produce

plan.label: 10 Plan
plan.full_name: Community forest conservation and management plan
plan.function: Community conservation and management plan for sustainable and equitable management

biodiversity.label: 11 Ecology
biodiversity.function: Protection of forest, wildlife, biodiversity, water sources and habitat

appeal_gs.label: A1 appeal
appeal_gs.full_name: Petition to SDLC against Gram Sabha resolution
appeal_gs.function: A person aggrieved by a Gram Sabha resolution may petition the SDLC within the statutory process

appeal_sdlc.label: A2 appeal
appeal_sdlc.full_name: Petition to DLC against SDLC decision
appeal_sdlc.function: A person aggrieved by an SDLC decision may petition the DLC

slmc.label: Oversight
slmc.function: Monitors the recognition and vesting process; includes state officials and PRI members

nodal.label: Reports
nodal.function: Receives returns and reports from the State Level Monitoring Committee

e2.relation: Verified claim goes to Gram Sabha decision

metadata.title: Forest Rights Act: Claim to Recognition and Stewardship
metadata.description: A document-based map of the Forest Rights Act claim process. Follow the numbered main path from claim filing and verification through the Gram Sabha, sub-divisional review, SDO handoff, and final decision. Red branches show appeal routes; grey nodes show state oversight and reporting. Purple nodes show recognized individual and community rights; green branches show community forest use, planning, and ecological stewardship.
